items:
Experience “Maurice au Mer” on the southside of Prominence, a gem among the Beaches of South Walton’s (think Seaside or Rosemary without the crowds) … located by WaterSound on the eastern end of 30A, between Seagrove, Seaside and Watercolor on one side and Alys Beach, Seacrest and Rosemary Beach on the other. This 5 bedroom, 4 1/2 bath home is on a large, private corner lot three blocks behind the retail hotspot The Big Chill (formerly The Hub), home to restaurants, entertainment and shopping - close enough to the action but far enough away so you don’t hear any noise. One of a limited number of floor plans that are the most highly sought-after ones in the neighborhood!

The 2-story, 2800 sq. ft. luxury home is not your typical beach house and offers details and amenities you would expect at home. Comfortably sleeps 11; ideal for two families or an extended family to vacation together.

Features include:
• 4 bedrooms plus bunk room
-Master on main with king bed and luxury bath (rainfall & regular showers plus freestanding tub)
-2 King suites on 2nd floor with king beds and luxury bath (shower)
-Twin room with two twin beds
-Twin bunk room (sleeps 2)
-Full-size air mattress that comfortably fits in one of King suites
• Full-size hall bath upstairs with shower/tub combo
• Large, open kitchen/family room with 12-ft high ceilings and 10 windows
• 60-inch smart TV in family room and 50-inch smart TVs in every bedroom
• Direct TV stream available in family room and bedrooms
• Upgraded wifi for faster internet and cell phone booster
• Desks in downstairs master and one upstairs bedrooms
• Private ½ bath on main floor
• Large, 350 sq. ft. screened-in porch with dining table & 4 chairs plus sofa & rockers seating area for 5+, curtains for privacy and outdoor lamps for “mood lighting” - OUR GUESTS RAVE ABOUT THIS & LOVE TO SPEND TIME HERE!
• Covered back patio with grill plus seating
• Large 500 sq. ft. 2-car garage available to renters
• Laundry room with washer/dryer

Other Home Highlights:

• Dining area table comfortably seats 10
• Kitchen bar seats 3
• Fully stocked kitchen with plenty of appliances, cookware and dishes to serve gourmet meals for large groups - crock pot, nutribullet, blender, immersion blender, soda stream, Keurig single serve and coffee pot etc.
• Family room seats 10+
• Outdoor shower
• Extras to make your stay easier: hairdryers; playpen and high chair; beach towels, chairs and toys, umbrella, wagon; dog gate and toys
• 6 bikes

About The Neighborhood:

We’ve got you covered with every detail:

Pools – 5000 sq. ft. resort-style pool on the north side surrounded by private cabanas, hammocks, an outdoor grilling & dining pavilion, fitness center, bath houses and palm trees. Smaller pool on the south side.

The Big Chill (formerly Hub 30a) – The Town Center of Prominence, known as The Big Chill (formerly The Hub), offers entertainment and shopping at your doorstep. The heart of space is a large covered event pavilion with a 25 feet cinema screen to enjoy movies, sporting events and concerts. Check out upcoming events at www.thebigchill.com.

Beach Access – There are two beach access points approximately one half mile on either side of the neighborhood. The beach access at Deer Lake State Park is breathtaking and offers plenty of parking; walk a long boardwalk over the dunes to the pristine beach below. Other beach access points are a short drive away.• For information on other beach access points, check out https://30a.com/beach-access-points/ and https://30a.com/walton-county-public-beach-access/ .

Golf Cart rentals available through one neighborhood authorized provider, 30A Gulf Carts, 850-502-9325.

Everything you need is within the Town of Prominence but if you want more, venture 15 minutes down the street to check out the nearby communities of Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, Alys Beach, Seaside and Watercolor.

Booking Requirements:

Age requirement policy: One (1) parent or guardian over the age of 35 must be present and staying in the property for every three (3) guests between the ages of 15 and 25.

Dog Friendly: This property is dog friendly for dogs over the age of six months with up-to-date shot records. Written permission must be obtained. Only one dog per stay. A $250 non-refundable pet fee applies.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

reviews.text: This is our 4th stay at Maurice Au Mer, and it was a wonderful stay! We celebrated our parents' 50th Anniversary with a family trip, and we had a comfortable amount of room for our 3 families. Communication was exceptional and the written instructions were very helpful. Check in and check out was so convenient, and the beach toys, chairs, and bikes were so nice to use and not have to pack. The kitchen was equipped to make family meals, and The Big Chill had great variety when we wanted to eat out.We would definitely come back to this home away from home again and again!
